newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends down in pre-expiry trade.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends down in pre-expiry trade.

text.p: London's May white sugar contract tumbled almost $6.00 on Monday with weakness blamed on pre-expiry book-squaring and the downward correction in New York.
May last traded down $5.80 at $306.00 after a new bout of selling toward the close and August was down $2.00 at $308.80 while other months also lost ground.
"It's all expiry stuff...but it looks shaky," said one trader.
As expected, New York saw a sell-off from last week's highs.
London activity was dominated by the standard rolling of spot positions into further forward months with commission houses and other brokers featuring on both sides of the market.

Other market sources said the reluctance of short holders to move out of the May contract suggested that a high delivery could be on the cards, possibly as much as 10 cargoes of European origin sugars.
